in_hebrew.name: Haleigh
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Haleigh הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word haleig, meaning 'healthy, or hale' and 'light, or leoht'. In English history, Haleigh can be traced back to the Normans, specifically the Old Norse name Halgr, which meant 'healthy' or 'whole'. Over time, the name evolved into Haleigh and gained the meaning 'bright' or 'light'.
